definitions: A withdrawal of troops or forces.
A maneuver in which a vehicle or aircraft moves out of a line or formation.
A section of a newspaper or magazine that can be detached.
A piece of furniture, such as a bed or table, that can be extended by pulling out a part.
examples: The pull out of troops was unexpected.
The pilot executed a perfect pull out.
She read the article in the pull out.
They bought a sofa with a pull out bed.
